name: Linear Approximation of Activation Functions for Probabilistic Affine Forms
aliases: Linear approximation of activation functions for probabilistic affine forms
definition: Approximates nonlinear activation functions with linear functions to enable analytical propagation of probabilistic affine forms through neural networks.
summary: This method analytically approximates nonlinear activation functions with linear ones to efficiently propagate uncertainty through Implicit Neural Representations, outperforming range analysis on periodic functions like Sine.
